metadata.title: Mean curvature nonpositivity and rational connectedness
metadata.abstract: Let $(X,\omega)$ be a compact Gauduchon manifold and let $E$ be a holomorphic vector bundle on $X$. We establish equivalent conditions for the existence of a Hermitian metric on $E$ with nonpositive mean curvature. For a non-uniruled compact Kähler manifold $X$ satisfying $\mu_{\omega_0,\max}(T_X)=0$ for some Gauduchon metric $\omega_0$, we show that the corresponding maximal destabilizing subsheaf of $T_X$ splits off holomorphically and is polystable of slope zero with respect to every Gauduchon metric. Its complement, if nonzero, is HN-negative with respect to every such metric. In particular, a compact Kähler manifold is not uniruled if and only if , for every Gauduchon metric $\omega$, its tangent bundle admits a Hermitian metric with nonpositive $\omega$-mean curvature. We also obtain an uniruledness criterion that includes the case where the maximal slope of $T_X$ is zero, and a Mumford-type characterization of rational connectedness. Under HN-nonnegativity of $T_X$ for one Gauduchon metric, rational connectedness, the vanishing of all holomorphic covariant tensors, and the condition $\kappa^+(X)=-\infty$ are equivalent.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.workSummary: 通过全纯向量丛的平均曲率非正性、Harder–Narasimhan 斜率及切丛分解，研究非单有理性和有理连通性。
analysis.breakthrough: 给出紧 Kähler 流形非单有理性的平均曲率刻画，并在特定斜率条件下建立有理连通性与协变张量消失的等价关系。
analysis.limitations: 平均曲率指向量丛曲率的收缩，并非超曲面的平均曲率；有理连通性等价命题依赖额外斜率假设。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

analysis.priorityReason: 把双有理几何性质转化为可分析的丛曲率条件。
